_comment: pm personal config template. pm-generate renders this to ~/.config/pm/config.json (gitignored). Each capability slot maps an abstract role to a concrete tool the user confirmed, or "none" to degrade. Skill logic reads slots, never tool names.

meeting_source._options: MCP/CLI/skill that pulls meeting notes & transcripts at session start, or "none"

tracker._options: issue/project tracker for due dates & status, or "none"

email._options: MCP/CLI/skill that reads your inbox for action items at session start, or "none"

notes_store._options: directory root where project files & archives live; defaults to ~/.pm-notes if unset
